changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'OrganizationDomain') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationDomain]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [OrganizationID] [int] NOT NULL, [Domain] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_OrganizationDomain] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_OrganizationDomain_Organization') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationDomain] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_OrganizationDomain_Organization] FOREIGN KEY([OrganizationID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Organization] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationDomain] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_OrganizationDomain_Organization] END
